So the cross colors swapped! The yellow cross became blue (4 parts + 1 white = 5 b nodes) and the blue cross became yellow (4 parts = 8... wait that doesn't add up).
Actually let me reconsider. Before:
- Y: 5 nodes = 4 single dots + 1 yellow cross (45 pixels)

After:

- b: 5 nodes = 4 single dots + 1 blue cross (the former yellow cross)
